motivation: The first logged-bank learned selector failed to transfer; a selector fitted to both realized route outcomes showed a small positive effect. In that first bank the logged fair assignment was shared across all private histories and all six bodies of a geometric scene. Test true single-route reward learning with new independent scenes and sampled actions over time, and compare to paired outcomes at the same total route/terminal budget. This is a follow-up; the first fit remains reported.
design: The same 17-parameter readout and continuous 20-preview-tick interaction as readback-plan. Inherit the same six uniform bodies, freeze only their inherited values for this isolated selector fit; their inside-life weights, biases and support remain fully writable. Fresh geometry streams for every training birth and update. Same physically offered pair and balanced private histories; no long-term API for accessing target/correct side.

arms.live: Per update/birth: 8 fresh worlds × 8 private histories × one route actually sampled from the current policy. No other continuation is executed. Learn from that single sampled terminal reward through ordinary policy gradient, using other independent worlds for centering.
arms.sampled_pair: 4 worlds × 8 private histories × two independent current-policy actions at the same prefix. Same subsequent random numbers across sister lives. Average policy-gradient scores over the observed payoffs.
arms.forced_pair: 4 worlds × 8 private histories × two actually experienced, opposing routes from the same prefix. Learn the route probability from its exact action-weighted realized rewards. Equal number of completed trajectories/terminal values to the live arm but additional access to common-prefix counterfactuals.

fit: Three preassigned training seeds (643793,643799,643801) per method. 4000 updates, 64 terminal samples per birth per update; Adam .01, KL-to-uniform .002 and weight penalty .0001. Initialize as for the first readout (fair choice). Deploy at the predeclared endpoint without tuning.
validation: Entirely new shared geometry per cohort, seed 9651577 original, 9651581 independent, 384 worlds. Four objects is primary; two/eight and transfer into the 12 mixed-repair bodies are secondary. Report physical sampled mean/all and donated-private-history, random and handcrafted weak-signal controls. Show outer-fit seed results separately. Independent-body test uses the same three shared readouts without any independent-body calibration.
